hotspots.title: Tensions rise over Trump administration's indefinite Iran conflict
hotspots.blurb: US missile strikes on Iranian oil tankers and escalating military warnings from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth have intensified focus on the Middle East conflict. Internal administration disputes over U.S. casualties and sharp public criticism from conservative figures like Tucker Carlson have exposed growing rifts over the war's indefinite timeline.
hotspots.affect: Direct military strikes, rising casualty disputes, and acute intra-right factional warfare over open-ended foreign intervention command maximum affective charge.

hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes Supreme Court on mail-voting restrictions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has turned to the Supreme Court after multiple federal courts blocked its attempts to alter USPS mail ballot rules and deploy voter purge databases. State attorneys general and voting rights groups have secured extended injunctions, setting up an intense battle ahead of the midterm elections.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes legal clashes over voting access and election administration trigger acute polarization around electoral integrity and perceived disenfranchisement.

hotspots.title: Rift deepens between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella
hotspots.blurb: Sharp political and strategic divergences between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have created a high-profile feud within France's Rassemblement National ahead of the 2027 presidential race. The internal conflict has intensified following the return of Marion Maréchal and controversial constitutional referendum proposals.
hotspots.affect: Existential leadership rivalries and bitter public infighting at the helm of Europe's most prominent far-right party drive intense media charge.

hotspots.title: Trump's MAGA Inc. launches $10M Texas Senate ad blitz
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's MAGA Inc. super PAC has committed $10 million to back Ken Paxton's U.S. Senate bid in Texas, marking the administration's first major financial push for the midterms. The heavy investment underlines conservative urgency to defend a traditionally reliable Republican seat against competitive Democratic challenges.
hotspots.affect: Massive midterm financial commitments and defensive urgency mobilize widespread attention across political networks.

hotspots.title: Norway's Progress Party surges in polls amid political shift
hotspots.blurb: Norway's right-wing Progress Party (FrP) reached historic polling highs of over 31%, solidifying its position as the country's largest political party. The dramatic surge has sparked intense debates over party leader Sylvi Listhaug's potential prime ministership against incumbent Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre.
hotspots.affect: Triumphant populist momentum colliding with mainstream establishment shock creates high affective narrative engagement.
